• A glimpse of the 2.93 KM Twin Tunnel on the Raipur–Visakhapatnam Economic Corridor!*
Located in Koraput district of Odisha, this impressive Twin Tunnel is part of *Package-08 (Kandili–Tumbigura)* of the Raipur–Visakhapatnam Economic Corridor (NH-130CD).
• Project Details:*
• Project: Raipur–Visakhapatnam Economic Corridor
• Package: OD-08 (Kandili–Tumbigura)
• Location: Koraput, Odisha
• Tunnel Type: Twin Tunnel
• Tunnel Length: Approximately 2,930 Metres
